name: Prepositions Potion Lab
imageAlt: Prepositions Potion Lab activity with Dr. Fizz and a colorful laboratory
description: Help Dr. Fizz brew a potion while practicing spatial concepts. Students listen to a direction, find the correct ingredient on the laboratory shelves, and add it to the beaker.

After three correct ingredients, the potion bubbles up and something silly happens. The playful cause-and-effect activity gives you opportunities to model location words, practice listening, and talk about what happens next.
skills: Prepositions, spatial concepts, listening, and following directions
includes: An interactive laboratory with spoken directions and animated potion surprises
requirements: For computers and laptops. See TPT for full product requirements.

name: Emoji Emotions
imageAlt: Emoji Emotions activity cover showing a range of expressive emoji faces
description: Explore feelings through six interactive games built around expressive emoji faces. Students can practice naming emotions, finding a matching face, and talking about how someone might feel.
Large buttons, simple screens, sound effects, and a read-aloud voice support shared play. Each game fits on one screen, making it easy to keep the activity in view during a screen-sharing session.
skills: Emotion vocabulary, identifying feelings, and expressive language
includes: Six interactive feelings games with sound effects and read-aloud support
requirements: For computers and laptops. See TPT for full product requirements.

name: Microwave Simulator
imageAlt: Microwave Simulator activity showing a pretend microwave with food and controls
description: This pretend-play microwave began with a student's special interest. It brings an everyday routine onto the screen so you can follow that curiosity and make space for communication.
Use the activity to model words such as open, start, and eat, invite requests, and comment together as you play. Follow the student's lead and adapt the language to the moment.
skills: Core words, requesting, commenting, and pretend play
includes: An interactive microwave simulator for shared language play
requirements: For computers and laptops. See TPT for full product requirements.
